subtitulo: Full container load international ocean transport from key Asian ports.
descripcion: We manage full container load ocean transport from Asia to Latin America.
queHacemos: Space booking and competitive rates with major global carriers
Coordinating empty container pickup and positioning at the factory
Bill of Lading (B/L) processing and export documentation at origin
Satellite tracking and itinerary monitoring to destination ports
Customs clearance and direct coordination with temporary warehouses in Callao and the region

beneficios.descripcion: Direct contracts with carriers to secure space even in peak seasons.
No hidden local charges or surprises at the port of arrival.
Direct routes and early coordination to avoid demurrage days.
Tariff alignment to take advantage of trade agreement benefits (Peru-China FTA).

etapas.detalle: Equipment assignment and departure confirmation from origin ports.
Port entry, export customs inspection, and stowage.
Monitoring the voyage across the Pacific.
Tally, deconsolidation, or full container pickup for delivery.

specs.Puertos de salida: Shanghai, Ningbo, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Qingdao, Yantian
specs.Puertos de destino: Callao, Paita (Peru), Guayaquil, San Antonio, Buenaventura
specs.Tiempos de tránsito: Approx. 28 to 35 days depending on direct or transshipment service
specs.Tipos de contenedor: 20' Standard, 40' High Cube, Reefer, Open Top
